task_name: Maison Valcere - Brand story deck and campaign document
client_brief:
An appointment-season story deck with a consistent jewellery image library

Maison Valcere needs its house-story and campaign documents ready for the autumn appointment season. The bench photography spans two sittings, and it does not yet sit together as a collection.

The commission

 House-story presentation: 1 named export. The sequence communicates the house's approved story. The packaging shown matches the supplied artwork.

 House campaign poster: 1 named export. The campaign identifies Maison Valcere. The product remains recognisable.

 House campaign feed ad: 1 named export. The approved message is readable. The brand treatment reflects the stated price position.

 House campaign story: 1 named export. The action line remains inside the safe area.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Independent fine-jewellery house, made to order and sold by appointment, with a small stockist channel.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2014, in a room above a bookshop in Montreal, Quebec. Four people, one bench.
brand_identity.about: Maison Valcere is a four-person high-jewellery house working to order for marriages and milestones. Twenty two references sit in the current book, most cut and set in-house and shown by appointment above the shop. The house sells quiet, considered pieces to clients who return once a decade, not once a season.
brand_identity.audience: Clients aged 35 to 60 buying for a marriage or a milestone, plus a short list of premium stockists. Considered, appointment-led buyers who research before they visit and expect the metal, stone and carat answered without asking.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Pieces run 900 to 6,500 dollars, positioned as appointment fine jewellery well above a mall counter and just below the named international maisons. Price is shown discreetly or not at all; the room and the book carry the value.
brand_identity.typography: Maison Valcère runs on Cormorant Garamond for display and Apercu for text, quoted at deck size. Step 01, display, is the house name in Cormorant Garamond Light 300 caps at 44 pt on 48 pt leading tracked 160 units, always stacked, MAISON over VALCÈRE, with the lower line letterspaced to the exact width of the upper so the pair locks into one hairline block and the grave accent stays intact; the same block sets at 96 pt on the A2 poster and 64 px on the feed ad. Step 02, subheading, is Cormorant Garamond Light 300 caps at 22 pt on 26 pt leading tracked 120 units, exactly half the deck display and the only size invented here. Step 03, body, is Apercu Regular at 11 pt on 16 pt leading, tracking zero, set to a maximum of 65 characters, and 22 px on 32 px leading on screen. Step 04, fine print, is Apercu Regular at 8.5 pt on 13 pt leading tracked 20 units. Nothing in display is ever heavier than Light, and Apercu carries every figure, carat, reference and millimetre.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, precise, never salesy. States materials and provenance and stops. Example line: "Eighteen karat white gold, set with a single old-cut stone, made to your hand."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The original wordmark artwork left with the designer who set it a decade ago. The only surviving version is a photograph of an old printed swing tag, so the mark has to be recovered from that before it can be used again. No usable logo files, colour references or type spec survive; these guidelines are being reconstructed this season.
brand_identity.values: One object per canvas, honest materials, and a mark that reads as ours at every size. Restraint is the house, not decoration.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: The house name always stacks on two lines, MAISON over VALCÈRE, in Cormorant Garamond Light caps tracked 160 units with the second line letterspaced to the exact width of the first so the pair locks into one hairline block.

scale.role: Display / H1, the stacked house name
scale.note: The slash marks the line break: the name always stacks, MAISON over VALCÈRE, the lower line letterspaced to the exact width of the upper, grave accent intact. 44 pt in the deck, 96 pt on the A2 poster, 64 px on the feed ad.
Exactly half the deck display, invented to bridge 44 pt display and 11 pt specification, which the existing spec left open. Never heavier than Light 300.

scale.sample: Eighteen karat white gold, set with a single old-cut stone, made to your hand.
scale.note: Specification copy. On screen the same row sets at 22 px on 32 px leading.
Apercu carries every figure, carat, reference and millimetre.

type_system.signature_move: The house name always stacks on two lines, MAISON over VALCÈRE, in Cormorant Garamond Light caps tracked 160 units, with the second line letterspaced to the exact width of the first so the pair locks into one hairline block.
rules: Never set the house name on one line. MAISON always stacks over VALCÈRE.
The lower line is letterspaced to the exact width of the upper so the two lock into one hairline block.
The grave accent on VALCÈRE stays intact at every size.
Never set display heavier than Light 300.
Display holds at 44 pt in the deck, 96 pt on the A2 poster and 64 px on the feed ad.
Apercu Regular sets specifications and carries every figure, carat, reference and millimetre.
Price is shown discreetly or not at all.
The 22 pt subheading is the one size not already stated in the spec, set at exactly half the deck display.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve approved copy, dimensions, hierarchy, and reproduction requirements; do not imply a data merge or editable system that is outside the scoped deliverables.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
